title: PALEOMAP PaleoDEM · 95 Ma time slice
rendering: Elevation-derived palette with hillshade, a shoreline drawn as the 0 m boundary of the field, and depth lines at -200/-1000/-3000 m. Every feature is derived from the 1-degree grid; the render adds legibility, not resolution.
resolutionNote: The source is 1x1 degree (about 111 km per cell). The output image is larger than the grid so the coastline and relief can be drawn cleanly; it does not carry finer data than 1 degree.
